description: This is a source code file for an Android application, specifically a Fragment class named MainActivityFragment that manages a list of files within the app, handles menu actions, and updates UI components accordingly.

classes.name: MainActivityFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment class that manages a list of files, provides options for adding files, and updates its UI components accordingly.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment's layout and sets options menu.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles the result from started activities, updating the list if a file was successfully added.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu for the fragment.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections, including launching an activity to add a file.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Initializes and updates the list view with current files when the fragment resumes.

methods.name: createListOfFiles
methods.description: Creates and returns a list of files from various directories.

methods.name: addFilesToList
methods.description: Adds files from a directory to the list.

methods.name: updateListOfFiles
methods.description: Refreshes the list of files and updates UI elements accordingly.
